plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that John Keel, a writer who investigated strange phenomena in the 1960s, reported cases of people hearing numbers spoken at them out of their television sets. He tells it as part of a wider picture in which some unknown intelligence reaches into ordinary people's lives in odd ways.
